events.text: U-254 was built in 1941 at Vegesack.
events.subject: self

events.text: U-254 conducted her warm-up and training period in the Baltic Sea in the first half of 1942.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She conducted her warm-up and training period in the Baltic Sea in the first half of 1942

events.text: U-254 was ordered to spend sometime cruising off Reykjavík, Iceland during this month-long journey.

events.text: U-254 sank a small British freighter on 2 August.
events.subject: self
events.quote: sinking a small British freighter on 2 August

events.text: The British ship was sunk by three torpedoes with all 45 crew on board six days later.
events.subject: self
events.quote: This was followed six days later by another success in a similar area, when the British ship was sunk by three torpedoes with all 45 crew on board

events.text: The Norwegian damaged U-254 with depth charges during an attack on a convoy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on this cruise, when the Norwegian damaged her with depth charges during an attack on a convoy

events.text: U-254 departed in late November 1942, returning to her old operating grounds of the North Atlantic routes.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After repairs, U-254 departed in late November 1942, returning to her old operating grounds of the North Atlantic routes

events.text: U-254 maneuvered to attack Convoy HX 217 in December.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In December, the weather in the region is atrocious and visibility practically nil, so as U-254 maneuvered to attack Convoy HX 217

events.text: U-254 was directed to Convoy HX 217 on 8 December.
events.subject: self
events.quote: to which she had been directed on 8 December

events.text: U-254 collided with another submarine in a freak accident.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The two submarines had become lost in the dark and collided with one another in a freak accident

events.text: 41 of U-254s crew were spilled into the ocean as the boat heeled over and sank.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 41 of U-254s crew, who were spilled into the ocean as the boat heeled over and sank

dropped.text: U-254 spotted and sank the 11,000 ton American tanker Esso Williamsburg with one torpedo on 3 October, killing 28.
